title: Learn 1.0.19 build 21 verified; USB transfer awaiting approval
summary: Current learning updates packaged into a signed ARM64 APK. Build and automated verification passed. Automatic approval review blocked export to the removable drive until explicitly authorized.

changes.detail: Produced signed version 1.0.19, version code 21, ARM64 APK containing the current learning features and prepared/retry reports.
Corrected browser scoring expectation and synchronized missing KaTeX dependency for release packaging.

validation.name: Source validation
validation.detail: 335 automated tests passed; TypeScript and focused universe ESLint passed. After version/report changes, all 12 focused release/history tests passed.

validation.name: Browser validation
validation.detail: Existing local web export passed English, Arabic, French checks: 16 routes and four viewport widths, nine playable games, score persistence, journey and flashcard interactions. No page errors. Home screenshot inspected.

validation.name: Android release
validation.detail: Gradle BUILD SUCCESSFUL; 13 native tests, zero errors/failures. Signature matches prior release signer. Version, native assets and current feature/report markers verified. 1426 staged application files matched source with no extras before the retry history entry.

validation.name: USB transfer
validation.detail: Automatic approval review rejected copying the private APK to D:/lecomax app because explicit authorization for that removable drive was required. No copy performed. Destination detected as D: ANDROID-X86.

validation.name: Physical device and delivery limitations
validation.detail: No installation or physical-phone testing, no deployment. This post-build report is in repository history and requires a subsequent build to appear in installed APKs. No current app preview claimed.
